news.headline: Nike Reaffirms Fiscal 2027 Guidance and Outlines 'Full Stride Ahead' Strategy
news.summary: Nike has reaffirmed its financial guidance for fiscal 2027 while detailing its 'Full Stride Ahead' strategic initiative aimed at driving sustainable growth.

news.headline: NIKE, Inc. Schedules Capital Markets Day
news.summary: NIKE, Inc. has scheduled a Capital Markets Day event for November 17, 2026.

news.headline: Nike Unveils New Footwear and Sportswear Innovations
news.summary: Nike introduced a range of new performance and lifestyle products, including updates to its Air, Mind, and Free footwear lines, during its "World of Athletes" showcase in Beaverton, Oregon.

news.headline: Senator Elizabeth Warren Calls for Breakup of Healthcare Conglomerates Including UnitedHealth
news.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren has publicly targeted major healthcare companies, including UnitedHealth Group, advocating for their breakup due to concerns over their market influence.

news.headline: UnitedHealthcare of Ohio Remains in State Marketplace for 2027
news.summary: UnitedHealthcare of Ohio, Inc. is confirmed as one of the five insurers remaining in the Ohio health insurance marketplace for the 2027 plan year following the withdrawal of other carriers.

news.headline: Mubadala Investment Co. PJSC Increases Stake in UnitedHealth Group
news.summary: Mubadala Investment Co. PJSC has increased its shareholding in UnitedHealth Group Incorporated to 31,419 shares, according to a recent SEC filing.

news.headline: Humana to Launch National Gold Card Program
news.summary: Humana Inc. announced the upcoming launch of its national Gold Card program, designed to streamline prior authorization requirements for high-performing providers.

news.headline: Humana Announces Final Results of Cash Tender Offers for Outstanding Debt Securities
news.summary: Humana Inc. announced the expiration and final results of its cash tender offers for several series of its outstanding senior notes.

news.headline: Humana Announces Pricing Terms of Offers to Purchase for Cash Certain of its Outstanding Debt Securities
news.summary: Humana Inc. has announced the reference yield and total consideration for its previously disclosed cash tender offers to purchase certain outstanding debt securities.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Initiates Coverage on Comfort Systems USA With Overweight Rating
news.summary: Morgan Stanley has initiated coverage on Comfort Systems USA, Inc. with an 'Overweight' rating and a price target of $1,410.

news.headline: B. Riley Adjusts Lumentum Price Target to $659
news.summary: B. Riley has lowered its price target for Lumentum Holdings Inc. from $770 to $659 while maintaining a Neutral rating.

news.headline: Lumentum Shares Decline Amidst Export Policy Risks and Industry Volatility
news.summary: Lumentum shares fell approximately 8% on November 16, 2026, following reports of new U.S. Commerce Department export policy risks and broader volatility in the optical and interconnect sector.

news.headline: Vertiv Expands 800 VDC Power Portfolio for AI Infrastructure
news.summary: Vertiv has introduced new 800 VDC systems designed to support high-density AI compute pods and data halls, extending its existing power infrastructure portfolio.

news.headline: Vertiv Launches ATLAS Lab for AI Infrastructure Testing in Collaboration with NVIDIA
news.summary: Vertiv has introduced the Vertiv ATLAS Lab, a new system-level testing facility designed to validate power, thermal management, and control infrastructure for AI workloads in partnership with NVIDIA.

news.headline: Aegis Critical Energy Defence Corp. Announces Strategic Partnership with GE Vernova and SK On
news.summary: Aegis Critical Energy Defence Corp. announced a new strategic partnership involving GE Vernova and SK On, alongside progress on a battery energy storage order.

news.headline: Homer City Generation Completes Delivery of First Two GE Vernova 7HA.02 Turbines
news.summary: Homer City Generation, L.P. announced the successful delivery and installation of the first two of seven GE Vernova 7HA.02 natural gas turbines at its energy campus.

news.headline: GE Vernova Announces SF6-Free Technology for Space-Constrained High-Voltage Substations
news.summary: GE Vernova has introduced a new SF6-free technology solution designed specifically for high-voltage substations where space is limited.

news.summary: Palo Alto Networks published its sixth annual State of Cloud Security Report, highlighting widespread security gaps and the prevalence of ungoverned AI in software pipelines.

news.summary: Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 threat intelligence division participated in the investigation of a cybersecurity breach at AI infrastructure provider Fireworks AI.

news.headline: ServiceNow and Genpact Expand Partnership for Agentic AI Workflows
news.summary: ServiceNow has partnered with Genpact to leverage the ServiceNow platform as a foundation for agentic AI, with Genpact providing design, configuration, and deployment services.

news.headline: Velatura Launches Workflow Integration Node™ in ServiceNow Store
news.summary: Velatura Public Benefit Corporation has released its Workflow Integration Node™ (WIN™) on the ServiceNow Store, enabling cross-organizational care coordination.

news.headline: Everbridge Named to ServiceNow Partner Advisory Council and Achieves Elite Partner Status
news.summary: Everbridge has been elevated to Elite Partner status within the ServiceNow Partner Program and appointed to the 2026 ServiceNow Partner Advisory Council.

news.headline: Corning Secures Major Optical Glass Order and Prepayments from Nvidia
news.summary: Corning has received a significant order for optical glass from Nvidia, supported by multi-billion-dollar plant prepayments to facilitate the expansion of manufacturing operations.

news.summary: Citigroup has updated its price target for EchoStar Corporation, raising it to $156 from the previous target of $139.

news.headline: Citigroup Adjusts Price Target on EchoStar to $139 From $117
news.summary: Citigroup has revised its price target for EchoStar Corporation, increasing it from $117 to $139.

news.headline: Microchip Technology Announces Sampling of New Automotive-Qualified Ethernet TSN Switch Families
news.summary: Microchip Technology has introduced its new LAN9324x and LAN9322x automotive-qualified Ethernet Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) switch families designed for next-generation in-vehicle networks.

news.headline: Microchip Technology Participates in ASA-ML Multi-Vendor Demonstration
news.summary: Microchip Technology's ASA-ML evaluation boards were used in a multi-vendor interoperability demonstration hosted by Rohde & Schwarz Japan.

news.headline: Freeport-McMoRan's Indonesian Joint Venture Announces Planned Notes Offering
news.summary: Freeport-McMoRan's Indonesian joint venture has unveiled plans for a new notes offering.

news.headline: Fair Isaac Corporation CEO William J. Lansing Sells Shares Worth $14.8 Million
news.summary: Fair Isaac Corporation CEO William J. Lansing sold 20,465 shares of company stock, valued at approximately $14.8 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

news.headline: Jefferies Adjusts Price Target on Newmont to $149 From $155
news.summary: Investment firm Jefferies has revised its price target for Newmont Corporation, lowering it from $155 to $149.

news.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
news.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

news.headline: TD Cowen Adjusts Broadcom Price Target to $425 From $475
news.summary: TD Cowen has revised its price target for Broadcom Inc. to $425, down from the previous target of $475.

news.headline: Coatue Management Increases Stake in Broadcom
news.summary: Coatue Management has increased its shareholding in Broadcom Inc. by 14.0%, bringing its total position to 6.7 million shares.

news.summary: Morgan Stanley has initiated coverage on EMCOR Group, Inc. with an Overweight rating and a price target of $799.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Initiates Coverage on Quanta Services with Equal Weight Rating
news.summary: Morgan Stanley has initiated research coverage on Quanta Services, Inc. with an "Equal Weight" rating.

news.headline: Non-Executive Director Ip Foo Wing Purchases Shares in Power Probe plc
news.summary: Power Probe plc announced that Non-Executive Director Ip Foo Wing, through the Ojai Valley Trust, acquired 9,800 ordinary shares in the company.

news.headline: Quanta Services Announces 18% Increase in Quarterly Cash Dividend
news.summary: Quanta Services, Inc. has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.13 per share, marking an approximately 18% increase from the previous dividend paid in October 2026.
